title.value: Interacting brains revisited: A cross-brain network neuroscience perspective
title.justification: The title 'Interacting brains revisited: A cross-brain network neuroscience perspective' was chosen because it precisely describes the main focus and methodology of the study, which is the use of a cross-brain network approach to understanding neural synchrony between interacting individuals.
title.quote:
RESEARCH ARTICLE

Interacting brains revisited: A cross-brain network neuroscience perspective

Christian Gerloff ^{1,2,3}

|

extractions.description: This research paper presents a comprehensive analytical framework for studying neural synchrony between interacting individuals through interbrain network analysis. Through the use of bipartite graphs, it investigates how and whether such graphs provide meaningful insights into the neural basis of social interactions. The paper explores both inference and prediction capacities of interbrain networks using innovative machine learning approaches such as nonnegative matrix factorization and graph-based embeddings.

sustainable_development_is_central.justification: The paper focuses primarily on neuroscience and social behavior without explicitly addressing climate change or ecological issues, thereby indicating that sustainable development is not a central theme.
sustainable_development_is_central.quote: Elucidating the neural basis of social behavior is a long-standing challenge in neuro... Such endeavors are driven by attempts to extend the isolated perspective on the human brain by considering interacting persons' brain activities...
